Package com.compdfkit.core.signature

Class CPDFExternalSignPrepareOptions

java.lang.Object
com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFExternalSignPrepareOptions
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public final class CPDFExternalSignPrepareOptions extends Object implements Cloneable
Settings frozen into a two-phase signature at preparation time.

Defaults use SHA-256, DOCUMENT_DIGEST, an invisible new field on page 0, and a 65536-byte CMS reservation. A visible rectangle uses PDF coordinates with an upward Y axis. Options and certificate arrays are copied when submitted. Do not mutate this object while submitting an operation.
